answer_1.quote: To evaluate the ability of MLLMs in understanding and creating Video Comment Art, we follow the evaluation methods of previous work , and designed two main categories of tasks: Discriminative Task and Generative Task.

answer_2.quote: The results of automated metrics and LLM-based evaluations are presented in Tab. 4

answer_3.quote: We use GPT-4o to comprehensively evaluate the generated comments based on Creativity, Quality, Style, and Impact

answer_4.quote: We also conduct a human preference study to evaluate the creativity of generated comments, asking users to select the most creative ones.
answer_4.guideline: asking users to select the most creative ones
